The theorem gives a complete sharp distribution over a natural full-dimensional one-parameter shape interpolation, with a nontrivial constant-dodecagon interval extending beyond the lone zonohedral member, two exact probabilistic regimes, and three singular parameter transitions. These are genuine structural classifications, not an arbitrary isolated finite computation.
